title: Cardiac MRI: the left atrium on 3D whole-heart MRI
description: Nineteen 3D whole-heart MRIs (1.5 T, free breathing with ECG and respiratory gating, one cardiac phase) of adults, read as axial images at 2.5 mm around the heart, each with an expert-corrected outline of the left atrium including its appendage and the stumps of the pulmonary veins (Medical Segmentation Decathlon, King's College London).

sources.name: Medical Segmentation Decathlon, Task 02 Heart (left atrium; King's College London)
sources.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (as written in the task's dataset.json and on the AWS Open Data registry page of the Decathlon)
sources.citation: Antonelli M, Reinke A, Bakas S, et al. The Medical Segmentation Decathlon. Nature Communications. 2022;13:4128. doi:10.1038/s41467-022-30695-9. Task data: King's College London, released through the Left Atrial Segmentation Challenge (Tobon-Gomez C, et al. IEEE Trans Med Imaging 2015;34:1460-1473). Simpson AL, et al., arXiv:1902.09063.
sources.accessNote: Task02_Heart.tar (455,721,472 bytes) downloaded anonymously from the public AWS Open Data bucket msd-for-monai (registry.opendata.aws/msd, no account); only imagesTr and labelsTr (20 cases with labels) are used. The licence was read from the tar's dataset.json and the registry page on 2026-11-09. The derived DICOM is shared under the same licence (CC BY-SA 4.0); changes: reformatted to axial DICOM, cropped and thinned to 2.5 mm, outlines traced per slice.

referenceTargets.label: Left atrium

provenanceDetail.method: Segmentation distributed with the Medical Segmentation Decathlon heart task (King's College London, Left Atrial Segmentation Challenge): the left atrium including the left atrial appendage, the mitral plane and the pulmonary vein end points were segmented by an expert using an automated tool followed by manual correction (Antonelli et al. 2022). Semi-automatic and expert-corrected, not drawn from scratch; this pack has not reviewed it again. The mask is on the original sagittal grid, kept on the axial reformat's slices, traced per slice with skimage find_contours (0.5) into image_px [col, row].
provenanceDetail.note: 30 slices at 2.5 mm; the whole mask is 96 ml (the cropped slices keep all of it). The label contains the blood pool of the atrium with the stumps of the pulmonary veins and the appendage; the atrial wall is not separated.

referenceTargets.unassessedNote: Dataset label of the left atrium only; the other chambers, the aorta and the pulmonary veins beyond their stumps are not outlined.
